def solve(inp):
    g=[list(map(int,r.split())) for r in inp.strip().split('\n')]
    H,W=len(g),len(g[0])
    bands=[]  # (row, list of (color, start, end)) runs
    for r,row in enumerate(g):
        runs=[];j=0
        while j<W:
            if row[j]!=0:
                c=row[j];s=j
                while j<W and row[j]==c: j+=1
                runs.append((c,s,j-1))
            else: j+=1
        bands.append((r,runs))
    out=[row[:] for row in g]
    # marker columns: nonband rows (single cells) at bottom
    marker_cols=set()
    for r,row in enumerate(g):
        for j,v in enumerate(row):
            if v!=0:
                # is this cell part of a band? band rows have runs len>2
                pass
    # find gap columns per band & marker columns: columns with cells only in bottom region
    # simpler: for each band run, gaps inside; fill gap + above
    for r,runs in bands:
        for c,s,e in runs:
            for j in range(s,e+1):
                if g[r][j]==0:
                    out[r][j]=c
                    for rr in range(r-1,-1,-1):
                        if g[rr][j]!=0: break
                        out[rr][j]=c
    return out

def parse(txt):
    return [list(map(int,r.split())) for r in txt.strip().split('\n')]
